calls.title: Neon + GrowthBook
calls.summary: The discussion centered on enhancing the usage of GrowthBook at NEOM, which currently relies heavily on manual processes and limited automation. Despite having over 200 live experiments, many show low impact, and recent activity has stalled, indicating adoption challenges. Non-technical users struggle with configurations, prompting suggestions for AI-driven solutions to simplify usage. The team prioritizes building expertise and establishing a governance framework to support effective experimentation. Additionally, plans to connect with GrowthBook experts aim to boost knowledge sharing, streamline integration with other analytics tools, and foster a culture of experimentation that utilizes the full capabilities of the platform, including future aspirations for AI-driven automated testing.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B testing, experimentation velocity, AI automation, feature flags, Neon platform

# Neon + Growthbook
Date: 2026-10-06 | Duration: 49.290000915527344m

## Summary
The discussion addressed how to expand experimentation while avoiding tests on the full user base because they increase costs and can skew results. The organization has run 700 experiments since January 2023 and aims to launch 30 new experiments monthly, but GrowthBook’s perceived complexity and process friction limit adoption. Training is planned for the core platform and twin teams, including approximately 15–20 participants, with emphasis on troubleshooting, best practices, feature flags, governance, and new features; sessions will mainly be in English, with possible Portuguese Q&A. GrowthBook 5.1 introduces contextual bandits, AI-generated experiment learnings and insights, enhanced product analytics, and AI-agent capabilities for experiment creation. Agent-driven experimentation is a desired future direction, although strong governance is needed first. Thursday at 5 p.m. Brazil time is preferred for training, and questions will be gathered beforehand. Renewal follow-up is planned, while Andy and Chris support commercial and technical needs respectively.

## Keywords
Experimentation, GrowthBook 5.1, contextual bandits, AI learnings, feature flags, training
